get.summary: Recognise a voucher code for your cart.
get.description: Says whether a voucher code is recognised for the caller's own cart. The seller is derived from the cart's lines, never from the request. Every miss answers the same 'not recognised'. Recognition does not apply the voucher.

get.description: Retrieves the invoice details for the specified invoice ID.

put.description: Updates the specified invoice for the tenant.

patch.description: Partially updates the specified invoice for the tenant.

delete.description: Deletes the specified invoice for the tenant.

put.description: Calculates the totals and taxes for the specified invoice.

post.description: Issues the specified Draft invoice: it becomes Signed and a payable obligation, and its amounts can no longer change. Issuing an invoice that is already issued succeeds and changes nothing.

post.summary: Issue a credit note against an issued invoice.
post.description: Issues a credit note in the invoice's currency that reduces what is owed on it: numbered from the tenant's credit note series and signed in one step. The amount cannot exceed what can still be credited, and an annulment credits all of it. The invoice must be issued and must not itself be a note.

post.summary: Issue a debit note against an issued invoice.
post.description: Issues a debit note in the invoice's currency that increases what is owed on it: numbered from the tenant's debit note series and signed in one step. The invoice must be issued and must not itself be a note.

get.summary: Get what can still be credited on an invoice.
get.description: The invoice's total plus its issued debit notes, minus its issued credit notes, in its own currency: the most a new credit note can credit.

get.summary: List the tenants that issue unnumbered invoices (root tenant only).
get.description: Invoice numbering is opt-in per tenant: a tenant without an enumeration range issues unnumbered invoices. Lists those tenants with the count and the latest issue instant, so a range can be configured. Only the instance's root tenant may call it.

post.summary: Backfill the issuance instant of legacy invoices (root tenant only).
post.description: One bounded run of the one-time backfill: stamps the issuance instant on up to batchSize legacy live invoices that were already payable obligations, without re-posting them, and records an audit entry. Run again until it reports 0. Only the instance's root tenant may call it.
